* **Goal:** Introduce Viviana Matsuda, her studio identity, and establish a welcoming, artistic tone.

### Beat 2: Introducing *Playful Pottery* (0:15 – 0:32)
* **Goal:** Present the book *Playful Pottery* and explain the concept of making clay approachable and playful.

### Beat 3: The Core Lesson — Embracing Mistakes and Kindness (0:32 – 0:48)
* **Goal:** Focus on the book's deeper message regarding self-compassion, letting go of perfectionism, and treating creativity with kindness.
* **A-Roll & Audio:** Viviana speaks about how working with clay teaches patience and self-forgiveness when things don't go as planned. [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 86.9s-98s]]
* **A-Roll / Voiceover:** She elaborates on how being kind to yourself during the creative process unlocks genuine creative freedom. [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 98s-107.6s]]
* **B-Roll:** Cut to hands shaping clay on the wheel and dynamic studio work. [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 84.3s-95s]]

### Beat 4: Resolution & Takeaway (0:48 – 1:00)
* **Goal:** Deliver an inspiring concluding thought on playfulness, creativity, and self-acceptance.
* **A-Roll & Audio:** Viviana wraps up with a warm concluding message encouraging people to explore their own creativity without fear. [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 107.6s-119.7s]]
* **B-Roll:** Conclude on a satisfying visual of the studio space and finished ceramics as the music swells gently to a close. [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 9.6s-14.2s]]

### **Editorial Plan: Viviana Matsuda – *Playful Pottery***

**Total Runtime:** ~60 Seconds  
**Mood:** Calm, inspiring, intimate, reflective  
**Music:** Ambient / Calm (`calm_ambient`)  

---

#### **Beat 1: Introduction (0:00 – 0:11)**
* **Visual:** Open cold on A-roll of Viviana seated in her studio, speaking directly to camera.
* **Audio:** Ambient room tone only (no music). Viviana introduces herself: *“I’m Viviana Matsuda. I do pottery for a living. My brand name is Mud Witch. I’m a full-time potter.”* [[clip: A001C002_240718OR | 14s-25s]]
* **Purpose:** Establish an intimate, grounded connection with Viviana and her craft before introducing musical accompaniment.

---

#### **Beat 2: Introducing *Playful Pottery* (0:11 – 0:28)**
* **Visual:** Transition from the interview to dynamic B-roll showcasing various finished pottery pieces and colorful glaze textures [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 0.3s-5.8s]], cutting to detailed close-ups of ceramics [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 9.6s-14.2s]] and raw clay work [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 5.9s-9.1s]].
* **Audio:** Fade in the gentle, contemplative track (`calm_ambient`). Viviana’s voiceover explains the premise of her book *Playful Pottery* and how it diverges from traditional rigid manuals by prioritizing exploration and accessibility [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 37.6s-57.4s]].
* **Purpose:** Introduce the book's core premise and establish the tactile visual world of her work.

---

#### **Beat 3: Creativity and Kindness (0:28 – 0:48)**
* **Visual:** A focused montage of Viviana working at the pottery wheel, shaping clay with care [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 56.9s-64.8s]], refining pottery edges [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 136.4s-145.1s]], and handling delicate sculptural forms [[clip: B003C028_240719CX | 15.1s-20.8s]].
* **Audio:** Over the ambient bed, Viviana elaborates on the book's primary lesson: practicing kindness toward oneself, letting go of perfectionism, and embracing the joy of making mistakes during creative exploration [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 119.8s-130.5s]].
* **Purpose:** Deliver the philosophical heart of the piece, linking ceramic technique to self-compassion.

---

#### **Beat 4: Completion & Joyful Outro (0:48 – 1:00)**
* **Visual:** Viviana putting the final touches on a completed piece on the wheel [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 198.4s-206s]]. Cut to a close shot of Viviana smiling and giggling warmly to camera [[clip: B003C039_240719DU | 7.9s-9.8s]].
* **Audio:** Final uplifting voiceover reflection resolves as the ambient track gently fades out under her laughter.
* **Purpose:** End on an uplifting, playful note that embodies the spirit of *Playful Pottery*.

---

### Beat 2: Introducing *Playful Pottery* (0:14–0:32)
- **A1 (Interview):** Cut on-camera to Viviana introducing the title and premise of her book: *"So my book is called Playful Pottery. I wanted something that was a more simplified book about pottery for beginners."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 26.2s-28.5s]] [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 30s-37.6s]]
- **B1 (B-Roll):** Cut to a colorful shelf display of her playful finished creations, showing sunglasses resting on decorative plates and ice cream sundae figurines. [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 21.5s-25.2s]] [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 29.2s-33.9s]]
- **A2 (Interview):** Return to Viviana explaining why she wanted to depart from traditional ceramics guides: *"I feel like what I always saw or referenced were these, like, big, hearty old school books that never really talked about color or, um, had super fun things to do in them. - **B2 (B-Roll):** Cut to b-roll of her finished pastel ceramics, watermelon containers, and mugs arranged neatly on display shelves. [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 9.6s-14.2s]]

- **A3 (Interview):** Viviana speaks on the book's deeper message for learners: *"I hope the book provides to its readers... general clay knowledge. But also, I really want people to be creative and be kind to themselves."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 86.9s-98s]] [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 98s-107.6s]]

---

### Beat 4: Resolution & Conclusion (0:48–1:00)
- **Visual & Audio:** Cut back to Viviana on camera in her studio to close on an empowering, direct message about embracing imperfections in the creative process: *"When you're kind to yourself, you are rolling with the punches. * **Visual & Audio:** Open on Viviana's on-camera interview introducing herself. [[clip: A001C002_240718OR | 14s-25s]]

* **Transition & Music:** Transition the score into a dreamy, uplifting track as she pivots to her philosophy and why she wrote *Playful Pottery*. [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 98s-107.6s]]

---

### Beat 3: What It Means to Be Kind (0:30 – 0:45)
* **Dialogue:** Viviana breaks down what kindness means in art—removing self-judgment and allowing yourself to experiment without fear of failure. [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 119.8s-130.5s]]
* **B-roll Overlays:**
  * Cut to detailed B-roll of glaze painting to visually ground the act of mindful craft. [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 21.3s-37.9s]]
  * Cut to outdoor B-roll of glaze painting in the open air to reinforce creative liberation and play. [[clip: B003C028_240719CX | 5.8s-11.2s]]
* **Mood:** Warm, encouraging, and process-oriented.

---

### Beat 4: The Core Takeaway – Be Creative, Be Kind (0:45 – 1:00)
* **Dialogue & Visual:** Return briefly to Viviana on camera delivering the concluding message of the book: wanting people to give themselves permission to be creative and be kind to themselves throughout their journey. [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 133.5s-147.2s]]
* **Closing B-roll:** Finish on a bright, expressive shot of completed colorful ceramic art. [[clip: B003C061_240719AN | 19.1s-24.8s]]
* **Pacing & Mood:** Uplifting, inspiring, leaving the audience with an inviting creative resolution.

### Beat 1: Introduction & Brand Origin (0:00–0:15)
* **Audio & Dialogue:** Begin directly on A-roll with Viviana introducing herself: "Hi, I'm Viviana Matsuda. Um, I do pottery for a living. I'm a full time potter." [[clip: A001C002_240718OR | 14s-25s]]. Right after she says "I'm a full time potter", a warm acoustic music bed fades in. Viviana continues in voiceover explaining the origin of her brand name, Mud Witch [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 682.6s-693.9s]].
* **Visuals:** As the music fades in, cut to a montage showing her finished pottery displayed on the studio shelf [[clip: B003C028_240719CX | 5.8s-11.2s]], followed by footage of her centering and throwing clay on the wheel [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 42.6s-52.4s]]. When she mentions the name "Mud Witch," cut to a close shot of the wooden "Mud Witch" sign resting on the shelf [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 9.6s-14.2s]].

### Beat 2: Body Positivity in Form (0:15–0:30)
* **Audio & Dialogue:** Viviana speaks about how embracing body positivity and self-acceptance directly influences the forms she creates, celebrating curves and voluptuous shapes in clay [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 728.5s-737.2s]].
* **Visuals:** Intercut between her interview and B-roll of her shaping soft, rounded silhouettes on the wheel, using her hands and water to smooth out distinct curves [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 84.3s-95s]].

* **Audio & Dialogue:** Viviana discusses how pottery creates a unique, intimate bridge between the maker and the user, emphasizing how people physically feel the "artist's hand" when holding a handmade piece [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 907.1s-923.6s]].
* **Visuals:** Cut to detailed, tactile close-ups of her hands carefully using trimming tools to carve textures and shape the clay [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 21.3s-37.9s]].

### Beat 4: Consumerism & The Enduring Soul of Ceramics (0:45–1:00)
* **Audio & Dialogue:** Viviana reflects on mass consumerism, explaining how ceramics stand apart from disposable commercial goods because handmade pottery carries history, soul, and longevity [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 1172.1s-1197.2s]].
* **Visuals:** Showcase an array of glazed, colorful finished pieces in natural light [[clip: B003C028_240719CX | 15.1s-20.8s]], concluding with a wide shot of Viviana working peacefully in her studio space [[clip: B003C061_240719AN | 6.5s-13.6s]] as the music gently resolves to black.

  * She wraps up the concept: *"I think those two things kind of just mushed together the learning clay and the body positivity."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 721.7s-728.5s]]

### Editorial Plan: Jason Deck / Nice Jewish Runners (60 Seconds)

#### Story Beat 1: Identity & Athletic Foundation (0:00 – 0:14)
* **Goal & Mood:** Establish Jason's identity as a competitive Jewish athlete with an intimate, cinematic opening.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Open on Jason introducing himself and his club: "My name's Jason Deck, I live in Brooklyn, New York, and I run with Nice Jewish Runners." [[clip: P1071636-003 | 114.81s-119.07s]] Cut to him summarizing his pride: "And I think that's like the biggest thing, especially as somebody who takes athletics with pride and also Judaism." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 68.69s-77.13s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Begin the training progression in slow motion with Jason tying his running shoes on a park bench [[clip: P1071641 | 27.63s-41.22s]], transitioning to him warming up with hamstring stretches along the track [[clip: P1071643 | 0s-6.9s]] and a quad stretch by the railing [[clip: P1071645 | 8s-16.59s]]. Overlay warm light flares to establish an elevated, cinematic tone [[clip: Lens_Flare_From_The_Street_Light_fhd_1184157 | 2s-10s]].
* **Music & Audio:** A subtle, contemplative instrumental track enters softly underneath, building atmospheric warmth. On-screen graphic introduces his name and club affiliation: *Jason Deck – Nice Jewish Runners*.

---

#### Story Beat 2: Yearning for Community & Jewish Pride (0:14 – 0:30)
* **Goal & Mood:** Shift to an emotional, reflective tone tailored for Jewish American Heritage Month, emphasizing solidarity and shared heritage.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason reflects on searching for connection: "...the one thing that I did see was a strong Jewish connection, and that was something I was yearning for, especially after October 7th, and even during some of the marathons that I had run, I was writing stuff like Am Yisrael Chai on my shoes, and nice Jewish runners was literally a club dedicated to that phrase," [[clip: P1071636-003 | 337.91s-343.29s]] [[clip: P1071636-003 | 343.63s-361.39s]]. He adds the pride of racing openly: "I get the pleasure of running with a nice Jewish club. Wearing McGein David on my penny and competing in races." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 59.05s-68.43s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Slow-motion detail shots showcasing cultural identity: a close-up of Jason wearing his silver Mezuzah and Star of David necklace [[clip: P1071659 | 4s-10.64s]], a low side lunge stretch on the track surface [[clip: P1071646 | 0s-7.02s]], and a close-up of the NJR logo on his jacket [[clip: P1071652 | 7s-14s]].
* **Editing & Pacing:** Slower cuts with deliberate focus on personal and cultural symbols, allowing the gravity of his words to resonate.

---

#### Story Beat 3: The Energy of the Run (0:30 – 0:45)
* **Goal & Mood:** Transition into high-energy, epic athletic motion, showing how team support elevates his performance.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason describes hearing support along the course: "But the one thing I do keep hearing is like NJR or like people showing in support. And for me, that's pretty special because I didn't have a team before coming to New York." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 292.04s-303.84s]] He notes the physical reaction: "You get that little tingle in the back of your skull and it's a really good feeling and it just makes you want to like do even better." [[clip: P1071637-002 | 320.62s-327.76s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Peak training flow in cinematic slow motion: tracking behind Jason as he jogs steadily on the track [[clip: P1071651 | 8.52s-14.42s]], an overhead aerial perspective tracking him running through New York streets [[clip: DJI_20260503181611_0001_D | 43s-75s]], a side-profile tracking shot in bright sun [[clip: P1071655 | 0s-4s]], and a powerful shot of Jason striding directly past the lens [[clip: P1071656 | 0.24s-8s]].
* **Editing & Pacing:** The musical bed swells with driving rhythm, matching quicker rhythmic cuts of full-stride running.

---

#### Story Beat 4: An Open Invitation (0:45 – 1:00)
* **Goal & Mood:** Conclude with warmth, joy, and the creative brief's requirement that the run club is open to everyone regardless of pace.
* **A-Roll / Dialogue:** Jason closes with an inviting smile: "Run with nice Jewish runners, and it's it's a great feeling to be around people that are willing to go pretty much any speed and Just have a conversation get some bopka and coffee after it's great" [[clip: P1071638 | 183.67s-196.71s]]
* **B-Roll / Visuals:** Visuals resolve on Jason breaking into a genuine, relaxed smile directly at the camera [[clip: P1071658 | 1s-6s]], layered with warm lens flare light leaks [[clip: Lens_Flare_From_The_Street_Light_fhd_1184157 | 2s-10s]].
* **Music & Graphics:** Music resolves warmly. Closing text slate displays: *Celebrating Jewish American Heritage Month* alongside the Nice Jewish Runners club logo and call-to-action. Fade to black.
